svg.text: Schematic of the town circa 1491 DR, from the wiki's interactive-map marker positions (5th-edition plan). Not to scale.
Positions are the wiki marker coordinates (y up, scaled). North at the top is inferred: the orchard lies west, Tresendar Manor east and the Triboar road north, as the text says.
Roads, the orchard, farm fields and manor hill are schematic and placed by eye between markers; individual houses (about 50 structures) are not drawn. Markers 5 and 8 are one site in two periods.
Sketched 2026-10-09 for the Faerun Economy Engine wiki. A working reconstruction, not a copy of the published map.
